migration.name: 20260909030000_mailroom_mailbox_accounts_and_items + 20260909040000_mailroom_relations_and_poll_status
migration.backfill: None. Creates MailboxAccount (empty) and adds nullable or defaulted mailroom columns to InboundChannelMessage, so every existing marketing row is untouched. The unique (channelId, externalMessageId) index tolerates existing rows because Postgres treats NULL message ids as distinct; a genuine duplicate pair would stop the migration and name itself rather than be dropped. The follow-on migration types lastPollStatus as MailboxPollStatus, renames mailboxId to mailboxRef, and adds the principal and WorkItem foreign keys NOT VALID. Applies cleanly against any existing data state.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Domain-lifecycle-managed (scripts/stewardship-exemptions.txt): an operator connects, pauses or removes a mailbox from /workspace/mailroom; removal deletes the row and unlinks its items (SetNull). Classified restricted because secretsEnc carries an encrypted mailbox credential.
